ellie_cs: heads up1 - NovaEdge flagged INV-NOV-7722; large burst after failover to apac-bk on 2026-02-28. customer asks for full waiver of burst + late fee.
rory_billing: quick metering: reserved_commit=120k token-hrs, burst=52.4k token-hrs, burst_charge=$9,814 (rate $0.1875). spike window 02/28 03:12-07:40 UTC, sustained ~4.5h.
infra-bot: automated: failover due to rapid node preemption; incident INC-APAC-6599.
ellie_cs: customer says they could not scale client side; they claim platform caused unexpected failover routing.
anika_finance: SLA covers availability; no explicit burst waiver. propose discretionary credit of 50% on burst line ($4,907) for relationship preservation, conditional on postmortem and signed acknowledgment that this is a one-time exception. need written approval.
javier_ae: NovaEdge is strategic; agree to 50% and will capture acceptance. let's avoid full credit to prevent precedent.
rory_billing: will prepare CreditMemo:-$4,907 and hold posting until CS uploads PM and customer confirms. tag reason GOODWILL_FAILOVER.
anika_finance: finance approves conditional credit: "Finance approves one-time goodwill credit of $4,907 for NovaEdge (INV-NOV-7722) pending postmortem and customer confirmation."
ellie_cs: sending message to customer now, request acknowledgement + ETA postmortem 48h. will update thread when reply received. :email:
